notes.title: Lost Lullabies v1.3 Update
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047263/553c7f1d04d18870fd23e236ec85f894d82b7b3c.png"][/img][/p][p]Lost Lullabies v1.3 Update[/p][p][/p][p]Patch Notes[/p][p]         This update adds a new Nightmare Difficulty for those looking for a tougher challenge, along with controller support and a few small improvements to minigames.[/p][p][/p][p]Nightmare Difficulty[/p][p]A new difficulty mode for elite ghost hunters, pushing your skills and nerves to the limit.[/p][p]One evidence type will be hidden[/p][p]No setup time before the first hunt[/p][p]Hunts last longer, and each kill extends the hunt duration[/p][p]Coke restores significantly less sanity[/p][p]Fuse box starts off by default[/p][p]Almost no hiding spots in any location[/p][p]Shady Dealer's Shop will not refresh its stock[/p][p][/p][p]Controller Support[/p][p]Full controller support is now available.[/p][p][/p][p]Changes & Tweaks[/p][p]In the Alex minigame, when the radio emits a sound, the board’s numbers now light up[/p][p]The requirement to access the Expel Evil phase is reduced from 3 to 2 correctly identified ghosts[/p][p]Clock interactions in the Margareth minigame now have visual feedback[/p][p][/p][p]Join our Discord to share any thoughts or feedback.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047263/d2d5d2e11ecd0e6cd29998c0168c97ddfe479719.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Paranormal Day
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047263/aee9f724411bc80169a1ae41d1df624d9fe3321e.png[/img]



May 3 National Paranormal Day Hotfix Update

We’ve just rolled out a update to smooth out a few rough edges and improve the overall experience. Here’s what’s changed:

-Gameplay & Mechanics

Adjusted colliders for smoother navigation.

Made Alex’s minigame Morse code puzzle easier.

Rebalanced item and quest prices for better pacing.

Lobby computer is now usable (password: 1234).

Fixed bug with telegraph interaction at close range.

-UI & UX

Polished UI elements for clarity and consistency.

Fixed UI bugs (misalignments, missing visuals).

Language and localization issues have been corrected for improved readability.

-Audio & Visual

Lowered jumpscare sound volume.

Minor visual improvements across scenes.

Added basic content censorship.

-Event Update

Added special assets for National Paranormal Day.

If you run into any issues, let us know.
Happy National Paranormal Day

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047263/d2d5d2e11ecd0e6cd29998c0168c97ddfe479719.png[/img]

notes.title: Lost Lullabies v1.1 Update
notes.notes:
Patch Notes

Performance Improvements:

Optimized texture sizes and materials.
Various optimization tweaks to ensure the game runs smoothly on all devices. We hope this improves the experience for everyone.

Bug Fixes:

Fixed an issue with Chris' hair.
Video camera rendering improved to better recognize ghost orbs.
Fixed an issue preventing Robert minigame kills.
Fixed a bug where telephones and radios could be heard in unintended locations.
Fixed cross item issues.

Graphics & Settings:

Added Shadow Distance option to Graphics Settings.
Added Screen Space Ambient Occlusion quality setting.
Brightness adjustments: The highest value is now more visible (not recommended).
FPS capping added to the lowest quality settings to prevent drops on low-end devices.

Gameplay & Controls:

Added X-Y Invert option to Controller Settings.
Added Camera Shake option to Gameplay Settings.
Ghost no longer continues hunting after the first kill on Normal difficulty.
Increased the chance of Spirit Box responses.
Item prices adjusted.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback! Your input helps us improve the game with every update. If you have any suggestions, bug reports, or just want to chat with the community, join us on Discord! We’d love to hear your thoughts and experiences. See you in the game!
[url=https://discord.com/invite/8UGagwgZKN] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047263/d2d5d2e11ecd0e6cd29998c0168c97ddfe479719.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Lost Lullabies v1.0 Update
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Ghost Hunters,[/b]
Here are the latest changes in this patch:
[list]
[*] Added in-game keybind customization.
[*] Increased the visibility duration of Ghost Spheres.
[*] Grace Period increased by 2 seconds across all difficulties.
[*] Increased the frequency of ghosts providing evidence.
[*] Reduced the frequency of ghosts initiating hunts.
[*] Ghost fingerprints now last longer (Normal and Hard modes only).
[*] Increased the detection range of the EMF.
[*] Reduced the maximum speed ghosts can reach.
[*] Stamina regeneration time reduced from 5 seconds to 4 seconds.
[*] Reduced the sanity drain effect of the Glimmer Stone.
[*] The prices of items have been reduced.
[*] Yurei's sanity drain rate has been increased.
[/list]
Thank you for your support. Please continue to share your feedback on [b]Discord.[/b]
[b]The Lost Lullabies Team[/b]

notes.title: Lost Lullabies is Out Now!
notes.notes:
It's been a long journey, but the day has finally come! Thanks to your support, Lost Lullabies: The Orphanage Chronicles is now available. Now you can jump in with your friends, explore the 80's horror vibes, and enjoy the experience together. 

Thank you for being with us every step of the way. We're committed to making the game even better with each update!

notes.title: Thank You for Supporting Our Journey!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047263/aee9f724411bc80169a1ae41d1df624d9fe3321e.png[/img]

Hey everyone, we just want to say a big thank you to the [b]200,000+ players[/b] who spent time with our demo and showed interest in our game. We appreciate you for playing our demo, giving us feedback, and for being a part of our community.

We’ve made the decision to close our demo so we can focus on the game for its early access release.

We invite everyone who wants to contribute to our game to join our Discord! If you'd like to be involved in the development process, we will be sharing the alpha test build password and weekly updates.

[b]Join our Discord server and get in touch with us.[/b]

[url=https://discord.gg/8UGagwgZKN][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047263/d2d5d2e11ecd0e6cd29998c0168c97ddfe479719.png[/img][/url]

[b]What's waiting for you in early access[/b]

[b]Improved Ghost System[/b]
We’ve improved the ghost AI, and with the addition of a line-of-sight system, ghosts will behave more intelligently.

[b]New Ghosts[/b]
20 unique ghosts, each with their own behaviors, and challenges.

[b]Shady’s Stash[/b]
The Shady’s Stash is expanding! You’ll find more items you can use for investigation.

[b]New Chapters[/b]
There will be 4 chapters to discover, each introducing a new ghost character with their own story to uncover.

[b]More Locations[/b]
Explore different areas of the orphanage as you unlock more chapters. 

[b]Minigames[/b]
Each ghost will have its own mini-game that expands its story and introduces unique mechanics.

[b]Ghost Events[/b]
The ghost hunting experience is getting even spookier with new ghost events and activities, adding more intense interactions to your investigations.

[b]Balancing[/b]
We are working hard to ensure the gameplay feels fair and rewarding. Additionally, there will be difficulty settings available in early access.

[b]Improved UI[/b]
Our user interface is being revamped to be more intuitive and user-friendly, making your gameplay experience easier and more enjoyable.

[b]Optimization[/b]
We’ve made significant performance improvements, ensuring the game runs more smoothly across a wider range of systems.

[b]Language Support[/b]
We’re adding more language options to make the game more accessible to a broader audience.

[b]More Voice Recognition[/b]
Ask even more questions using the Spirit Box and Ouija Board! For players without a microphone, we’re introducing a text-based system to ensure everyone can engage with these items effectively.

[b]Fewer Bugs[/b]
Last but not least, we are working hard to fix bugs, ensuring a much more polished experience for all players.


[b]Be sure to join our Discord channel and follow us on social media for more.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047263/553c7f1d04d18870fd23e236ec85f894d82b7b3c.png[/img]

notes.title: Lost Lullabies Patch 0.071024 (Hotfix)
notes.notes:
[b]Patch  0.071024 [/b]

Hello everyone!
 
We’re thrilled to announce that our game was one of the most-played demos during the Next Fest! Alongside this success, we’ve made significant improvements regarding the issue of disconnecting from the server. We believe that most of the problems have been resolved. If you encounter any issues, please feel free to provide us with your feedbacks. Happy gaming!

[b]Patch Notes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where items would get stuck and constantly make noise.
[*] Fixed an issue where items obtained from the Mysterious Chest were not visible in   multiplayer.
[*] Fixed an issue where in-game sounds and radio communications were incorrectly adjusted.
[*] Fixed an issue where the master volume did not function in the main menu.
[*] Minor UI fixes have been made.
[*] Now, the room owner can kick other players!
[*] The difficulty of the Exorcism of Emma has been balanced.
[*] Benchmark scene has been added.
[/list]

notes.title: Lost Lullabies Patch 0.031024 (Hotfix)
